0022600216.text: The Trail Blazers, 6-2 through eight games and 2nd in the Northwest, host the 8-2 Oklahoma City Thunder, who lead the Northwest and have won four straight. Portland is 5-1 on the road but 1-1 at home, and it enters on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Trail Blazers lost 1-3 to the Thunder in 2025-26, including a 124-95 loss in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Robert Williams III (rest), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee).
